overview: The committee selected six building design finalists to submit to the MSBA for the high school project's feasibility study. The meeting also authorized a city-wide informational mailer and approved monthly project invoices.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the meetings held on February 25 and March 17, 2026.

items.title: February 2026 Invoices
items.summary: Approved invoices for February 2026 totaling $283,969.08 for project management, estimating services, and environmental and geotechnical surveys.

items.title: Community Informational Mailer
items.summary: Authorized a city-wide informational mailer, costing between $8,000 and $15,000, to increase project awareness and direct residents to the engagement website.

items.title: Selection of Design Alternatives
items.summary: Selected six building design alternatives to submit to the MSBA following a review of community feedback and committee deliberation on 29 conceptual options. The final short-list includes Option A (Code Upgrade), B1.2 (Addition/Renovation), C2.2, C3.4, D1.1, and D2.1.
